overview: Two dockets: a 1930 Jardine Matheson request to ship nitration toluol to Dairen's Mukden Arsenal, and 1935 correspondence with Dayton, Price & Co. on whether an export license was needed for a sporting-arms shipment to Dairen.

people.name: D. H. Wardell
people.role: Representative of Jardine, Matheson & Co. Ltd.

subfiles.title: Docket sheet on shipment of nitration toluol to Dairen
subfiles.about: This docket sheet records correspondence concerning permission to ship nitration toluol to Dairen for use by the Mukden Arsenal.
subfiles.summary: Jardine, Matheson (via Wardell) sought permit procedures to ship nitration toluol to Dairen for the Mukden Arsenal; State's September 19 reply explained procedure, enclosing blank applications.

subfiles.title: List of papers on Dayton, Price & Co. shipment to Dairen
subfiles.about: This sheet lists four items of correspondence about the licensing of a Dayton, Price & Co. shipment of sporting arms or munitions to Dairen.
subfiles.summary: Dayton, Price & Co. corresponded with State over a sporting-arms shipment to Dairen; State said no export license was needed, replying again when the company followed up.

interest: Shows State handling export requests for explosive and arms shipments to Japanese-controlled Dairen before the war.
